name: Маг
original_text: Вы можете либо выбрать другого игрока и поменяться с ним картами, либо сбросить с руки любое количество карт, чтобы взять столько же карт из колоды.

qa.name: pass: exact original Cyrillic title visually verified
qa.rank: pass: exact numeral and source emblem retained
qa.text: pass: full original ability text visually compared word by word, including numerals and punctuation
qa.composition: Female face, curly dark hair, red dress, yellow cloth, dove and window retained; small hair and clothing marks reinterpreted.
qa.identity: pass: source gender, apparent age, face, expression and pose retained; generative fine-detail interpretation
qa.color: pass: original palette family and light mood retained; restrained painterly contrast; exact 10% chroma reduction unmeasured
qa.layout: pass: full rectangle, title/rank area and original ability scroll retained; no district UI or new text

limitations: Generative restoration may reinterpret fine details and typography contours.
Approximately 10% lower color intensity is a prompt target, not a pixel measurement.
Raw generated PNG copied byte-for-byte; no resize, JPEG conversion, crop, padding or public game asset replacement.

artisticApproval.statement: Принимаю. только убедись, чтобы пергамент на персонажах остался на прежнем месте и был выровнен
artisticApproval.condition: Preserve and align parchment positions against each original character JPG.
